title: File:Risotto of leek, mushroom, pea, spinach - Relish Food Store AUD14 (4139673555).jpg
description: I was hungry, so I went for a hearty risotto. It was very tasty, and obviously made with a good stock. I would have been happy to have just a leek and mushroom risotto. Julia thought that the peas seemed to detract from the rich, silkiness of the rice, and I agreed. In that old-skool way, the waitress asked if I'd like cracked pepper on it, even before I had a chance to taste it :) Just as well I declined. The seasoning was fine just as it was. --- Relish Food Store (03) 9578 9058 256 McKinnon Rd McKinnon VIC 3204 Reviews: - Relish Food Store - www.miettas.com.au/ The Age Cheap Eats 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009; The Age Good Food Guide 2005, 2006 - Postcodes: 3204 Ormond - by Carolyn Holbrook, Epicure, The Age, November 28, 2006 A champion of consistently high-quality food that keeps everyone from fussy five-year-olds and food-trendy mums to keep-it-plain-and-simple grandmas happy. Love the salmon, dill and potato cakes, egg and bacon pie and baked lemon cheesecake.

title: File:Vermicelli alle vongole lupino.jpg
description: E' tradizione  che in occasione della cena della Vigilia di Natale, si prepari  un menù  di pesce, dove la prima portata sarebbe costituita dagli spaghetti alle vongole. Sembra che questa usanza abbia origini antiche e che sia  tramandata  dal  primo piatto di spaghetti alle vongole che sarebbe stato servito alla vigilia di Natale del 1762 alla corte di Ferdinando IV di Borbone, re del Regno di Napoli. Inoltre il libro 'Cucina teorico-pratica' di Ippolito Cavalcanti,  pubblicato nel 1837 parla dei vermicelli all’aglio con le vongole
